name: Real estate photography prices from photographers' price lists
description: Published prices of 154 US real estate photographers and photo companies in 24 metros, read from each business's own pricing page on 3 November 2026: the base photo package by home size, photos included, turnaround, and the drone, video, twilight and 3D tour add-ons, with the source URL, the day it was read and notes on anything that limits comparability.
creator: October (october-ai.com)

changelog.change: First release: 154 price lists in 24 metros, each read from the business's own pricing page on 3 November 2026.
